column1: # Book 5 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). No findings. 5.1348 = 5.528 verbatim (same Latin). 5.1302-1304 rebalanced so that Poeni stays in 1303. 5.1344-1346 recast: ante ... quam = before it happened. 5.1266, 5.1275, 5.1314, 5.1317, 5.1319, 5.1330, 5.1347 brought into the band; 5.1267 lengthened.

column2: so they might make weapons and be able to cut down forests,
and hew the timber, and plane the beams smooth,
now bronze lies neglected, gold has risen to the highest honor.
Then the Lucanian oxen, tower-bodied, grim, {{NOTE: "Lucanian oxen" are elephants, first met by Romans in Lucania in Pyrrhus' army (280 BC)}}
snake-handed, the Carthaginians taught to bear the wounds
of war, and throw the great troops of Mars into confusion.
savage, with no distinction, they threw the squadrons into rout,
frightened by the roaring, and turn them with reins on the enemy.
on every side, and made for the faces of those who came on, {{NOTE: source prints "patebant"; read "petebant", "made for"}}
For the horses shied sideways to escape the tusk's fierce thrust,
if they did it at all. But I am hardly persuaded that they
could not have sensed in their minds beforehand and seen,
before it happened, how common and foul an evil it would be.
And you could more readily maintain this was done in the whole,
